description: Post-prefill GPU memory footprint comparison: baseline (no far-skip) vs evict (compact+evict ring). Measured after 1 decode step triggers eviction of skip_far=True layers (static mask: 13/36 layers).

config.evict_geom: near_len=4096, near_pages=32, sink=4, window=128, block=64 → ring_capacity = 4551
config.measurement_point: torch.cuda.memory_allocated() after 1 decode step (eviction trigger point)

interpretation: Each of the 13 skip_far layers frees (L - sink) far-KV storage at eviction time; steady-state decode-step growth is small vs the one-time release. Savings scale with context length because prefill full KV grows linearly while ring stays constant.
cross_check: Single-layer bench kv_storage savings (87% @ 32K, 93% @ 64K, 97% @ 128K) are per-layer figures. Full-model savings are smaller (~3-6%) because only 13/36 layers are evicted and model weights dominate the footprint.
